goal: Resolve project-specific engineering doctrine for active development of the Constellation Skills corpus.

questions.question: What is the project-specific meaning of proven effectiveness?
questions.resolution: Verify every mechanism cleanly; ground effectiveness in feedback from real projects, not invented projects.
questions.human_answer: We need clean verification of all mechanistic pieces and rely on feedback collected from agents in real projects; we do not need arbitrary projects.

questions.question: How should collected feedback govern a skill change?
questions.resolution: Feedback is advisory and should be pursued aggressively.
questions.human_answer: It is really advisory; we have been treating things as something to be aggressively chased and may need to improve that.

questions.question: What disposition does each advisory feedback item require?
questions.resolution: Keep a lightweight freeform post-job feedback record, optionally inviting positives and negatives; later work interprets it.
questions.human_answer: The intent is freeform post-job feedback recorded for later issues; keep it super light and easy, perhaps collecting positives and negatives.

questions.question: May feedback collection block completion?
questions.resolution: No; feedback does not block completed work.

questions.question: What repository actions may agents take directly?
questions.resolution: Local commits are allowed; remote Git actions require approval unless pre-approved.
questions.human_answer: Local commits are allowed; push, PR creation, and merging need my approval, which may be pre-approved for specified work.

questions.question: What verification is required for a changed mechanism?
questions.resolution: Use targeted automated tests plus the relevant broader suite; explicitly justify a genuine no-test-surface exception.

questions.question: Are any other project-specific doctrine departures needed?
questions.resolution: All remaining engineering areas retain the inherited rigorous default.

signoff.statement: Confirmed: the shared Charter understanding is complete.
